hm.farmer.title: Everything your tank can tell you
hm.farmer.lead: Pick your tank from the list or the map below, or start with one of these.
hm.farmer.s1.d: See at a glance if your tank has more or less water than usual: green, amber or red.
hm.farmer.s2.d: The crops that suit your tank and the rain right now, in plain words.
hm.farmer.s3.d: Plan the next 12 weeks and find the best time to sow each crop.
hm.farmer.s4.d: A short weekly message, the rain this hour and a warning before heavy rain.
hm.farmer.s5.d: Mark your land and get three crop plans with the reasons behind them.
hm.farmer.s6.d: Type in Sinhala or English and get an answer with its source.
hm.farmer.b3: Works on a phone, even offline
hm.learn.title: Learn and play with water, weather and climate
hm.learn.lead: Picture stories, little games and challenges. No account needed.
hm.learn.s1.d: 16 picture stories about water, weather and climate, each with a small game.
hm.learn.s2.d: Match, sort and grow crops with a friendly drop guide.
hm.learn.s3.d: Steer a cloud, feed thirsty crops and run your own little farm.
hm.learn.s4.d: Quizzes and puzzles that use real tank data.
hm.learn.s5.d: Earn drops, badges and a certificate you can print.
hm.learn.b2: Progress saved on your own device
hm.officer.title: Every tank at a glance
hm.officer.lead: A dashboard for agricultural officers and instructors, built from NASA satellite data.
hm.officer.cta: Sign in to open the dashboard
hm.officer.title2: What you get after signing in
hm.officer.s1.d: Signals, water versus usual and rain for every tank, with filters and search.
hm.officer.s2.d: Rain for the next 6 hours and how green the land is, from NASA MODIS.
hm.officer.s3.d: A CSV for your spreadsheet and a clean printable report.
hm.officer.s4.d: Only registered officers: sign in with your phone number and a short code.
hm.officer.b1: See which tanks need a visit first
hm.research.title: Check how it works, and where it does not
hm.research.lead: The method, the tests and the known problems, all in the open.
hm.research.s1.d: Three separate parts and open rules, explained step by step.
hm.research.s2.d: Backtests against simple baselines, good results and bad.
hm.research.s3.d: Data limits and weak spots, listed openly.
hm.research.s4.d: The code and every saved data file, ready to rerun.
